card.name: Partway into drug names in interactions
card.fires_on: Mostly the first or middle piece of a drug name (Apalutamide, atazanavir, zidovudine, nitrous oxide) in drug-interaction text. Also fires on a few small linking words like "in" or "the" in other text.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Early pieces of a long drug name in interaction sections, before the rest of the name is spelled out.

modes.label: Linking words before a key term
modes.description: A small word such as "in" or "the" in plain prose, just before a predictable next word.
